venture-formations/aiprodaily/newsletter.title: newsletter-campaign-workflow

venture-formations/aiprodaily/nextjs-api.title: nextjs-api-routes
venture-formations/aiprodaily/nextjs-api.description: Next.js 15 API route patterns, NextRequest, NextResponse, error handling, maxDuration configuration, authentication, request validation, server-side operations, route handlers, and API endpoint best practices. venture-formations/aiprodaily/skill-deve.title: skill-developer
venture-formations/aiprodaily/skill-deve.description: Create and manage Claude Code skills following Anthropic best practices. Use when creating new skills, modifying skill-rules.json, understanding trigger patterns, working with hooks, debugging skill activation, or implementing progressive disclosure. Covers skill structure, YAML frontmatter, trigger types (keywords, intent patterns, file paths, content patterns), enforcement levels (block, suggest, warn), hook mechanisms (UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse), session tracking, and the 500-line rule.
venture-formations/aiprodaily/skill-deve.descriptionEn: Create and manage Claude Code skills following Anthropic best practices. Use when creating new skills, modifying skill-rules.json, understanding trigger patterns, working with hooks, debugging skill activation, or implementing progressive disclosure. Covers skill structure, YAML frontmatter, trigger types (keywords, intent patterns, file paths, content patterns), enforcement levels (block, suggest, warn), hook mechanisms (UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse), session tracking, and the 500-line rule.
venture-formations/aiprodaily/skill-deve.descriptionCn: 遵循 Anthropic 最佳实践创建和管理 Claude Code 技能。在创建新技能、修改 Skill-rules.json、了解触发模式、使用挂钩、调试技能激活或实施渐进式披露时使用。涵盖技能结构、YAML frontmatter、触发器类型（关键字、意图模式、文件路径、内容模式）、执行级别（阻止、建议、警告）、挂钩机制（UserPromptSubmit、PreToolUse）、会话跟踪和 500 行规则。

venture-formations/aiprodaily/supabase-d.title: supabase-database-ops
venture-formations/aiprodaily/supabase-d.description: Critical guardrail for Supabase database operations ensuring multi-tenant isolation with publication_id filtering, proper use of supabaseAdmin, avoiding SELECT *, error handling patterns, and secure server-side database access. Use when writing database queries, working with supabase, accessing newsletter_campaigns, articles, rss_posts, or any tenant-scoped data.
venture-formations/aiprodaily/supabase-d.descriptionEn: Critical guardrail for Supabase database operations ensuring multi-tenant isolation with publication_id filtering, proper use of supabaseAdmin, avoiding SELECT *, error handling patterns, and secure server-side database access. vercel-labs/add-skill/find-skills.title: find-skills

vercel-labs/agent-browser/agent-browser.title: agent-browser

vercel-labs/agent-browser/agent-browser.descriptionEn: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. vercel-labs/agent-browser/agent-browser.descriptionCn: 自动执行浏览器交互以进行 Web 测试、表单填写、屏幕截图和数据提取。当用户需要导航网站、与网页交互、填写表单、截取屏幕截图、测试 Web 应用程序或从网页中提取信息时使用。

vercel-labs/agent-browser/dogfood.title: dogfood
vercel-labs/agent-browser/dogfood.description: Systematically explore and test a web application to find bugs, UX issues, and other problems. Use when asked to "dogfood", "QA", "exploratory test", "find issues", "bug hunt", "test this app/site/platform", or review the quality of a web application. Produces a structured report with full reproduction evidence -- step-by-step screenshots, repro videos, and detailed repro steps for every issue -- so findings can be handed directly to the responsible teams.
vercel-labs/agent-browser/dogfood.descriptionEn: Systematically explore and test a web application to find bugs, UX issues, and other problems. Use when asked to "dogfood", "QA", "exploratory test", "find issues", "bug hunt", "test this app/site/platform", or review the quality of a web application. vercel-labs/agent-browser/vercel-sandbox.title: vercel-sandbox

vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-intelligent-.description: Apply when implementing search functionality, faceted navigation, or autocomplete in a headless VTEX storefront. Covers product_search, autocomplete_suggestions, facets, banners, correction_search, and top_searches endpoints, plus analytics event collection. Use for any custom frontend that integrates VTEX Intelligent Search API for product discovery and search result rendering.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-intelligent-.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing search functionality, faceted navigation, or autocomplete in a headless VTEX storefront. Covers product_search, autocomplete_suggestions, facets, banners, correction_search, and top_searches endpoints, plus analytics event collection. Use for any custom frontend that integrates VTEX Intelligent Search API for product discovery and search result rendering.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/headless-intelligent-.descriptionCn: 在无头 VTEX 店面中实现搜索功能、分面导航或自动完成时应用。涵盖product_search、autocomplete_suggestions、facet、banner、 Correction_search 和 top_searches 端点，以及分析事件集合。用于集成 VTEX 智能搜索 API 的任何自定义前端，以进行产品发现和搜索结果呈现。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-catalog-s.title: marketplace-catalog-sync
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-catalog-s.description: Apply when building catalog or SKU synchronization logic for VTEX marketplace seller connectors. Covers the changenotification endpoint, SKU suggestion lifecycle, product data mapping, price and inventory sync, and fulfillment simulation. Use for implementing seller-side catalog integration that pushes SKUs to VTEX marketplaces with proper notification handling and rate-limited batch synchronization.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-catalog-s.descriptionEn: Apply when building catalog or SKU synchronization logic for VTEX marketplace seller connectors. Covers the changenotification endpoint, SKU suggestion lifecycle, product data mapping, price and inventory sync, and fulfillment simulation. Use for implementing seller-side catalog integration that pushes SKUs to VTEX marketplaces with proper notification handling and rate-limited batch synchronization.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-catalog-s.descriptionCn: 在为 VTEX 市场卖家连接器构建目录或 SKU 同步逻辑时应用。涵盖变更通知端点、SKU 建议生命周期、产品数据映射、价格和库存同步以及履行模拟。用于实施卖方目录集成，通过适当的通知处理和限速批量同步将 SKU 推送到 VTEX 市场。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-fulfillme.title: marketplace-fulfillment
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-fulfillme.description: Apply when implementing fulfillment, invoice, or tracking logic for VTEX marketplace seller connectors. Covers the Order Invoice Notification API, invoice payload structure, tracking updates, partial invoicing for split shipments, and the authorize fulfillment flow. Use for building seller-side order fulfillment that integrates with VTEX marketplace order management including the 2.5s simulation timeout.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-fulfillme.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing fulfillment, invoice, or tracking logic for VTEX marketplace seller connectors. Covers the Order Invoice Notification API, invoice payload structure, tracking updates, partial invoicing for split shipments, and the authorize fulfillment flow. Use for building seller-side order fulfillment that integrates with VTEX marketplace order management including the 2.5s simulation timeout.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-fulfillme.descriptionCn: 在为 VTEX 市场卖家连接器实施履行、发票或跟踪逻辑时应用。涵盖订单发票通知 API、发票有效负载结构、跟踪更新、拆分装运的部分发票以及授权履行流程。用于构建与 VTEX 市场订单管理集成的卖方订单履行（包括 2.5 秒模拟超时）。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-order-hoo.title: marketplace-order-hook
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-order-hoo.description: Apply when implementing order integration hooks, feeds, or webhook handlers for VTEX marketplace connectors. Covers Feed v3 (pull) vs Hook (push), filter types (FromWorkflow and FromOrders), order status lifecycle, payload validation, and idempotent processing. Use for building order integrations between VTEX marketplaces and external systems such as ERPs, WMS, or fulfillment services.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-order-hoo.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing order integration hooks, feeds, or webhook handlers for VTEX marketplace connectors. Covers Feed v3 (pull) vs Hook (push), filter types (FromWorkflow and FromOrders), order status lifecycle, payload validation, and idempotent processing. Use for building order integrations between VTEX marketplaces and external systems such as ERPs, WMS, or fulfillment services.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-order-hoo.descriptionCn: 在为 VTEX 市场连接器实现订单集成挂钩、提要或 Webhook 处理程序时应用。涵盖 Feed v3（拉）与 Hook（推）、过滤器类型（FromWorkflow 和 FromOrders）、订单状态生命周期、有效负载验证和幂等处理。用于在 VTEX 市场和外部系统（例如 ERP、WMS 或履行服务）之间构建订单集成。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-rate-limi.title: marketplace-rate-limiting
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-rate-limi.description: Apply when implementing retry logic, rate limit handling, or resilience patterns in VTEX API integrations. Covers VTEX rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset, Retry-After), 429 status handling, exponential backoff with jitter, circuit breaker patterns, and request queuing. Use for any VTEX marketplace integration that must gracefully handle API throttling and maintain high availability.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-rate-limi.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing retry logic, rate limit handling, or resilience patterns in VTEX API integrations. Covers VTEX rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset, Retry-After), 429 status handling, exponential backoff with jitter, circuit breaker patterns, and request queuing. Use for any VTEX marketplace integration that must gracefully handle API throttling and maintain high availability.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/marketplace-rate-limi.descriptionCn: 在 VTEX API 集成中实现重试逻辑、速率限制处理或弹性模式时应用。涵盖 VTEX 速率限制标头（X-RateLimit-Remaining、X-RateLimit-Reset、Retry-After）、429 状态处理、抖动指数退避、断路器模式和请求排队。用于任何必须妥善处理 API 限制并保持高可用性的 VTEX 市场集成。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-async-flow.title: payment-async-flow
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-async-flow.description: Apply when implementing asynchronous payment methods (Boleto, Pix, bank redirects) or working with callback URLs in payment connector code. Covers undefined status response, callbackUrl notification, X-VTEX-signature validation, sync vs async handling, and the 7-day retry window. Use for any payment flow where authorization does not complete synchronously.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-async-flow.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing asynchronous payment methods (Boleto, Pix, bank redirects) or working with callback URLs in payment connector code. Covers undefined status response, callbackUrl notification, X-VTEX-signature validation, sync vs async handling, and the 7-day retry window. Use for any payment flow where authorization does not complete synchronously.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-async-flow.descriptionCn: 在实现异步支付方法（Boleto、Pix、银行重定向）或在支付连接器代码中使用回调 URL 时应用。涵盖未定义的状态响应、callbackUrl 通知、X-VTEX 签名验证、同步与异步处理以及 7 天重试窗口。用于授权未同步完成的任何支付流程。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-idempotency.title: payment-idempotency
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-idempotency.description: Apply when implementing idempotency logic in payment connector code or handling duplicate payment requests. Covers paymentId as idempotency key, payment state machine transitions, retry semantics for cancellation and refund operations, and requestId handling. Use for preventing duplicate charges and ensuring correct Gateway retry behavior across Create Payment, Cancel, Capture, and Refund endpoints.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-idempotency.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing idempotency logic in payment connector code or handling duplicate payment requests. Covers paymentId as idempotency key, payment state machine transitions, retry semantics for cancellation and refund operations, and requestId handling. Use for preventing duplicate charges and ensuring correct Gateway retry behavior across Create Payment, Cancel, Capture, and Refund endpoints.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-idempotency.descriptionCn: 在支付连接器代码中实现幂等性逻辑或处理重复的支付请求时应用。涵盖作为幂等键的 paymentId、支付状态机转换、取消和退款操作的重试语义以及 requestId 处理。用于防止重复收费并确保跨“创建付款”、“取消”、“捕获”和“退款”端点的网关重试行为正确。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-pci-security.title: payment-pci-security
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-pci-security.description: Apply when handling credit card data, implementing secureProxyUrl flows, or working with payment security and proxy code. Covers PCI DSS compliance, Secure Proxy card tokenization, sensitive data handling rules, X-PROVIDER-Forward-To header usage, and custom token creation. Use for any payment connector that processes credit, debit, or co-branded card payments to prevent data breaches and PCI violations.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-pci-security.descriptionEn: Apply when handling credit card data, implementing secureProxyUrl flows, or working with payment security and proxy code. Covers PCI DSS compliance, Secure Proxy card tokenization, sensitive data handling rules, X-PROVIDER-Forward-To header usage, and custom token creation. Use for any payment connector that processes credit, debit, or co-branded card payments to prevent data breaches and PCI violations.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-pci-security.descriptionCn: 在处理信用卡数据、实施 secureProxyUrl 流或使用支付安全和代理代码时应用。涵盖 PCI DSS 合规性、安全代理卡令牌化、敏感数据处理规则、X-PROVIDER-Forward-To 标头使用以及自定义令牌创建。用于处理信用卡、借记卡或联名卡支付的任何支付连接器，以防止数据泄露和 PCI 违规。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-provider-prot.title: payment-provider-protocol
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-provider-prot.description: Apply when implementing a VTEX Payment Provider Protocol (PPP) connector or working with payment/connector endpoint files. Covers all nine required endpoints: Manifest, Create Payment, Cancel, Capture/Settle, Refund, Inbound Request, Create Auth Token, Provider Auth Redirect, and Get Credentials. Use for building or debugging any payment connector that integrates with the VTEX Payment Gateway.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-provider-prot.descriptionEn: Apply when implementing a VTEX Payment Provider Protocol (PPP) connector or working with payment/connector endpoint files. Covers all nine required endpoints: Manifest, Create Payment, Cancel, Capture/Settle, Refund, Inbound Request, Create Auth Token, Provider Auth Redirect, and Get Credentials. Use for building or debugging any payment connector that integrates with the VTEX Payment Gateway.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/payment-provider-prot.descriptionCn: 在实现 VTEX 支付提供商协议 (PPP) 连接器或使用支付/连接器端点文件时应用。涵盖所有九个必需端点：清单、创建付款、取消、捕获/结算、退款、入站请求、创建身份验证令牌、提供商身份验证重定向和获取凭证。用于构建或调试与 VTEX 支付网关集成的任何支付连接器。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-app-structure.title: vtex-io-app-structure
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-app-structure.description: Apply when creating or modifying manifest.json, service.json, or node/package.json in a VTEX IO app. Covers builders (node, react, graphql, admin, pixel, messages, store), policy declarations, dependencies, peerDependencies, and app lifecycle management. Use for scaffolding new VTEX IO apps, configuring builders, or fixing deployment failures related to app structure and naming conventions.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-app-structure.descriptionEn: Apply when creating or modifying manifest.json, service.json, or node/package.json in a VTEX IO app. Covers builders (node, react, graphql, admin, pixel, messages, store), policy declarations, dependencies, peerDependencies, and app lifecycle management. Use for scaffolding new VTEX IO apps, configuring builders, or fixing deployment failures related to app structure and naming conventions.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-app-structure.descriptionCn: 在VTEX IO应用程序中创建或修改manifest.json、service.json或node/package.json时应用。涵盖构建器（node、react、graphql、admin、pixel、messages、store）、策略声明、依赖项、peerDependency 和应用程序生命周期管理。用于搭建新的 VTEX IO 应用程序、配置构建器或修复与应用程序结构和命名约定相关的部署失败。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-graphql-api.title: vtex-io-graphql-api
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-graphql-api.description: Apply when working with GraphQL schema files in graphql/ or implementing resolvers in node/resolvers/ for VTEX IO apps. Covers schema.graphql definitions, @cacheControl and @auth directives, custom type definitions, and resolver registration in the Service class. Use for exposing data through GraphQL queries and mutations with proper cache control and authentication enforcement.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-graphql-api.descriptionEn: Apply when working with GraphQL schema files in graphql/ or implementing resolvers in node/resolvers/ for VTEX IO apps. Covers schema.graphql definitions, @cacheControl and @auth directives, custom type definitions, and resolver registration in the Service class. Use for exposing data through GraphQL queries and mutations with proper cache control and authentication enforcement.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-graphql-api.descriptionCn: 在使用 graphql/ 中的 GraphQL 架构文件或在 Node/resolvers/ 中为 VTEX IO 应用程序实现解析器时应用。涵盖 schema.graphql 定义、@cacheControl 和 @auth 指令、自定义类型定义以及 Service 类中的解析器注册。用于通过 GraphQL 查询和突变公开数据，并进行适当的缓存控制和身份验证强制执行。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-masterdata.title: vtex-io-masterdata
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-masterdata.description: Apply when working with MasterData v2 entities, schemas, or MasterDataClient in VTEX IO apps. Covers data entities, JSON Schema definitions, CRUD operations, the masterdata builder, triggers, search and scroll operations, and schema lifecycle management. Use for storing, querying, and managing custom data in VTEX IO apps while avoiding the 60-schema limit through proper schema versioning.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-masterdata.descriptionEn: Apply when working with MasterData v2 entities, schemas, or MasterDataClient in VTEX IO apps. Covers data entities, JSON Schema definitions, CRUD operations, the masterdata builder, triggers, search and scroll operations, and schema lifecycle management. Use for storing, querying, and managing custom data in VTEX IO apps while avoiding the 60-schema limit through proper schema versioning.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-masterdata.descriptionCn: 在 VTEX IO 应用程序中使用 MasterData v2 实体、模式或 MasterDataClient 时应用。涵盖数据实体、JSON 模式定义、CRUD 操作、主数据生成器、触发器、搜索和滚动操作以及模式生命周期管理。用于在 VTEX IO 应用程序中存储、查询和管理自定义数据，同时通过适当的模式版本控制避免 60 个模式的限制。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-react-apps.title: vtex-io-react-apps
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-react-apps.description: Apply when building React components under react/ or configuring store blocks in store/ for VTEX IO apps. Covers interfaces.json, contentSchemas.json for Site Editor, VTEX Styleguide for admin apps, and css-handles for storefront styling. Use for creating custom storefront components, admin panels, pixel apps, or any frontend development within the VTEX IO react builder ecosystem.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-react-apps.descriptionEn: Apply when building React components under react/ or configuring store blocks in store/ for VTEX IO apps. Covers interfaces.json, contentSchemas.json for Site Editor, VTEX Styleguide for admin apps, and css-handles for storefront styling. Use for creating custom storefront components, admin panels, pixel apps, or any frontend development within the VTEX IO react builder ecosystem.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-react-apps.descriptionCn: 在react/下构建React组件或在store/中为VTEX IO应用程序配置存储块时应用。涵盖用于站点编辑器的 Interfaces.json、contentSchemas.json、用于管理应用程序的 VTEX Styleguide 以及用于店面样式的 css-handles。用于创建自定义店面组件、管理面板、像素应用程序或 VTEX IO React 构建器生态系统中的任何前端开发。

vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-service-apps.title: vtex-io-service-apps
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-service-apps.description: Apply when building backend service apps under node/ in a VTEX IO project or configuring service.json routes. Covers the Service class, middleware functions, ctx.clients pattern, JanusClient, ExternalClient, MasterDataClient, and IOClients registration. Use for implementing backend APIs, event handlers, or integrations that must use @vtex/api clients instead of raw HTTP libraries.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-service-apps.descriptionEn: Apply when building backend service apps under node/ in a VTEX IO project or configuring service.json routes. Covers the Service class, middleware functions, ctx.clients pattern, JanusClient, ExternalClient, MasterDataClient, and IOClients registration. Use for implementing backend APIs, event handlers, or integrations that must use @vtex/api clients instead of raw HTTP libraries.
vtexdocs/ai-skills/vtex-io-service-apps.descriptionCn: 在 VTEX IO 项目中的 node/ 下构建后端服务应用程序或配置 service.json 路由时应用。涵盖 Service 类、中间件函数、ctx.clients 模式、JanusClient、ExternalClient、MasterDataClient 和 IOClients 注册。用于实现必须使用 @vtex/api 客户端而不是原始 HTTP 库的后端 API、事件处理程序或集成。

wdavidturner/product-skills/growth-loops.title: growth-loops

wdavidturner/product-skills/growth-loops.descriptionCn: 当被要求“增长循环”、“建立增长引擎”、“设计病毒循环”、“创建内容循环”、“超越付费获取”或“为什么增长不复合”时使用。帮助设计自我强化的增长系统，将输出变成输入。增长循环框架（来自 Brian Balfour / Reforge 和 Elena Verna）将思维从线性漏斗转变为复合循环。

wdavidturner/product-skills/hierarchy-of.title: hierarchy-of-engagement

wdavidturner/product-skills/hierarchy-of.title: hierarchy-of-marketplaces

Helps founders and product leaders build defensible marketplace businesses by sequencing supply and demand. wdavidturner/product-skills/hooked-model.title: hooked-model

wdavidturner/product-skills/jobs-to-be-d.descriptionCn: 当被问到“要做的工作”、“JTBD”、“客户流失的原因”、“准备客户访谈”、“雇用和解雇产品”或“寻找真正的竞争对手”时使用。帮助发现未满足的需求以及购买决策背后的背景。 “待完成的工作”框架（由 Clayton Christensen 和 Bob Moesta 创建）解释了客户雇用和解雇产品的原因。

wdavidturner/product-skills/okrs.title: okrs

The OKR framework (originated by Andy Grove at Intel, popularized by John Doerr at Google) creates alignment, focus, and learning cycles. Christina Wodtke's Radical Focus approach emphasizes simplicity and avoiding common pitfalls.
wdavidturner/product-skills/okrs.descriptionEn: Use when asked to "set OKRs", "objectives and key results", "quarterly OKR planning", "align objectives", "measure OKR progress", or "focus priorities with OKRs". **Guardrail**: do not invent facts; do not add/remove/move citation keys; do not move citations across subsections; the argument ledger is an intermediate artifact and must never be inserted into the paper.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: deliverable-selfloop

**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: Do not invent papers/citations/results. Only use in-scope inputs already present in the workspace.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: draft-polisher
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Audit-style editing pass for `output/DRAFT.md`: remove template boilerplate, improve coherence, and enforce citation anchoring.
**Trigger**: polish draft, de-template, coherence pass, remove boilerplate, 润色, 去套话, 去重复, 统一术语.
**Use when**: a first-pass draft exists but reads like scaffolding (repetition/ellipsis/template phrases) or needs a coherence pass before global review/LaTeX.
**Skip if**: the draft already reads human-grade and passes quality gates; or prose is not approved in `DECISIONS.md`.
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not add/remove/invent citation keys; do not move citations across subsections; do not change claims beyond what existing citations support.

**护栏**：不要添加/删除/发明引文键；不要跨小节移动引用；不要改变超出现有引文支持范围的主张。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: evaluation-anchor-checker
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Audit and rewrite evaluation/numeric claims to ensure they carry minimal protocol context (task + metric + constraint) and avoid underspecified model naming.
**Trigger**: evaluation anchor checker, numeric claim hygiene, underspecified numbers, protocol context, 评测锚点检查, 数字断言, 指标上下文.
**Use when**: before final merge/polish, or when reviewers would likely flag claims as underspecified (numbers without task/metric/budget), or `pipeline-auditor` warns about suspicious model naming.
**Skip if**: evidence is too thin to justify numeric claims (route upstream to C3/C4), or you are pre-C2 (NO PROSE).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not invent numbers; do not add/remove/move citation keys; if protocol context is missing, weaken/remove the numeric claim rather than guessing.

**触发器**：评估锚点检查器、数字声明卫生、未指定的数字、协议上下文、足球变量点检查、数字断言、指标上下文。
**使用时间**：在最终合并/完善之前，或者当审阅者可能将声明标记为未指定（没有任务/指标/预算的数字）时，或者“管道审核器”警告可疑模型命名时。
**如果**则跳过：证据太薄弱，无法证明数字主张的合理性（上游路线至 C3/C4），或者您处于 C2 之前（无散文）。

**Guardrail**: analysis-only; do not edit evidence/writing artifacts; do not invent facts/citations; only write the TODO report.

**Guardrail**: Do not summarize or rewrite the paper; store the raw text (or a faithful extraction) so claims stay traceable.

**Guardrail**: 明确 overlap 与 delta；尽量给出可追溯证据来源（来自稿件/引用/作者陈述）。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: opener-variator
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Rewrite subsection openers so they stop reading like a generated table-of-contents: remove \"overview/narration\" stems and reduce repeated opener cadences across H3s.
**Trigger**: opener variator, opener rewrite, rewrite openers, overview opener, 开头改写, 小节开头, 去overview, 去旁白.
**Use when**: `writer-selfloop` is PASS but flags repeated opener stems / overview narration in `output/WRITER_SELFLOOP_TODO.md`, or the draft still has a subtle “generator cadence”.
**Skip if**: you are pre-C2 (NO PROSE), or the section is evidence-thin (route upstream; don’t stylize filler).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not invent facts; do not add/remove/move citation keys; do not move citations across subsections; keep meaning intact.

**触发器**：开场白、重写开场白、重写开场白、概览开场白、开头改写、小节开头、去概览、去旁白。

**护栏**：不要编造事实；不要添加/删除/移动引文键；不要跨小节移动引用；保持意义完整。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: outline-budgeter
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Merge/simplify an over-fragmented outline to hit a paper-like section budget (NO PROSE): target final ToC ~6–8 H2, fewer thicker H3.
**Trigger**: outline budget, merge sections, too many sections, H3 explosion, 大纲预算, 合并小节, 大纲太碎.
**Use when**: `outline/outline.yml` exists but would produce thin sections (too many H2/H3); before (or immediately after) `section-mapper`.
**Skip if**: outline is already within budget and approved; or you are already drafting prose.
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: NO PROSE; do not invent new topics; keep scope consistent; if you change section ids, you must reset mapping.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: outline-refiner

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: paragraph-curator
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Structured paragraph curation for C5: **select -> evaluate -> subset -> fuse**, so drafts converge instead of only expanding.
**Trigger**: paragraph curator, curation, select evaluate fuse, paragraph selection, 选段, 评价, 融合, 收敛, 去冗余.
**Use when**: you are in C5, `sections/*.md` exist, and the writing loop drifts toward 'longer by accumulation' (repetition, redundant paragraphs, weak synthesis).
**Skip if**: evidence packs are thin / `evidence-selfloop` is BLOCKED; or you are pre-C2 (NO PROSE).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not invent facts; do not add/remove citation keys; do not move citations across subsections; keep section-level claims consistent with `output/ARGUMENT_SKELETON.md# Consistency Contract`.

**使用when**：你在C5中，`sections/*.md`存在，并且写作循环朝着“通过积累而变长”的方向漂移（重复、冗余段落、弱综合）。

**护栏**：不要编造事实；不要添加/删除引用键；不要跨小节移动引用；保持节级声明与“output/ARGUMENT_SKELETON.md# Consistency Contract”一致。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: pdf-text-extractor

**触发器**：调查视觉效果、时间线、图表、视觉效果、图表、时间线、图表规格。
**使用时**：调查的C4（NO PROSE），已有大纲+主张/证据+引文，需要把时间线/图规格落盘。

**网络**：无。

**Trigger**: synthesis, evidence synthesis, systematic review writing, 综合写作, SYNTHESIS.md.
**Use when**: systematic review 完成 screening+extraction（含 bias 评估）后进入写作阶段（C4）。
**Skip if**: 还没有 `papers/extraction_table.csv`（或 protocol/screening 尚未完成）。
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: 以 extraction table 为证据底座；明确局限性与偏倚；不要在无数据支撑时扩写结论。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: table-filler
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:

**Trigger**: table filler, fill tables, evidence-first tables, index tables, 表格填充, 索引表.
**Use when**: table schema exists and evidence packs are ready; you want a compact, citation-backed index table to support later writing and Appendix table curation.
**Skip if**: `outline/tables_index.md` already exists and is refined (>=2 tables; citations in rows; no placeholders).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not invent facts; every row must include citations; do not write paragraph cells.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: table-schema
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Define evidence-first table schemas for a survey: what each table must answer, row unit, columns, and which evidence-pack fields are required to fill it.
**Trigger**: table schema, schema-first tables, table design, 表格 schema, 先 schema 后填充.
**Use when**: you want survey tables that are verifiable and fillable before LaTeX (typically Stage C4, after evidence packs exist).
**Skip if**: `outline/table_schema.md` already exists and is refined (covers both index tables and Appendix tables; no placeholders; evidence mapping is explicit).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: no invented facts; schema must be checkable and map each column to an evidence source.

**护栏**：没有捏造事实；架构必须是可检查的并将每列映射到证据源。

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: taxonomy-builder

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: terminology-normalizer
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Normalize terminology across a draft (canonical terms + synonym policy) without changing citations or meaning.
**Trigger**: terminology, glossary, consistent terms, 术语统一, 统一叫法, 术语表.
**Use when**: the draft has concept drift (same thing called 2–3 names) or global-review flags terminology inconsistency.
**Skip if**: you are still changing the outline/taxonomy heavily (do that first).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not add/remove citation keys; do not introduce new claims; avoid moving citations across subsections.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: transition-weaver
willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.description:
Generate lightweight section/subsection transitions (NO NEW FACTS) to prevent “island” subsections; outputs a transition map that merging/writing can weave in.
**Trigger**: transition weaver, weave transitions, coherence, 过渡句, 承接句, 章节连贯性.
**Use when**: `outline/subsection_briefs.jsonl` exists and you want coherent flow before/after drafting (typically Stage C5).
**Skip if**: `outline/transitions.md` exists and is refined (no placeholders).
**Network**: none.
**Guardrail**: do not add new factual claims or citations; transitions may only refer to titles/RQs/bridge terms already present in briefs.

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: tutorial-module-writer

willoscar/research-units-pipeline-skills.title: unit-executor

wimolivier/postgresql-best-practices/pos.title: postgresql-best-practices
wimolivier/postgresql-best-practices/pos.description:
PostgreSQL 18+ comprehensive best practices for enterprise database development. Provides schema
architecture patterns, Table API design, PL/pgSQL coding standards, migrations, and data warehousing.

USE THIS SKILL WHEN THE USER:
- Creates PostgreSQL schemas, tables, functions, procedures, or triggers
- Asks about PostgreSQL data types (uuid, text, timestamptz, jsonb, numeric)
- Writes PL/pgSQL code and needs naming conventions (l_, in_, io_, co_ prefixes)
- Implements Table API pattern (SECURITY DEFINER functions, schema separation)
- Sets up database migrations or schema versioning
- Needs index optimization, constraint design, or query performance help
- Asks about PostgreSQL 18+ features (uuidv7, virtual columns, temporal constraints)
- Builds data warehouses with Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
- Needs data lineage tracking, ETL patterns, or audit logging
- Reviews database code for best practices or anti-patterns
- Migrates from Oracle PL/SQL to PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL
- Sets up CI/CD pipelines for database changes

CORE PATTERNS:
- Three-schema separation: data (tables) → private (internal) → api (external)
- Table API: All access through SECURITY DEFINER functions with SET search_path
- Native migration system: Pure PL/pgSQL alternative to Flyway/Liquibase
- Trivadis naming: l_ (local), in_ (input), io_ (inout), co_ (constant)

wimolivier/postgresql-best-practices/pos.descriptionCn:
PostgreSQL 18+ 企业数据库开发的全面最佳实践。提供架构
架构模式、表 API 设计、PL/pgSQL 编码标准、迁移和数据仓库。

当用户出现以下情况时使用此技能：
- 创建 PostgreSQL 模式、表、函数、过程或触发器
- 询问 PostgreSQL 数据类型（uuid、text、timestamptz、jsonb、numeric）
- 编写 PL/pgSQL 代码并需要命名约定（l_、in_、io_、co_ 前缀）
- 实现表 API 模式（SECURITY DEFINER 函数、模式分离）
- 设置数据库迁移或架构版本控制
- 需要索引优化、约束设计或查询性能帮助
- 询问 PostgreSQL 18+ 功能（uuidv7、虚拟列、时间约束）

- 审查数据库代码的最佳实践或反模式
- 从 Oracle PL/SQL 迁移到 PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL
- 为数据库更改设置 CI/CD 管道

核心模式：
- 三模式分离：数据（表）→私有（内部）→api（外部）
- 表 API：通过带有 SET search_path 的 SECURITY DEFINER 函数进行所有访问
- 原生迁移系统：Flyway/Liquibase 的纯 PL/pgSQL 替代方案
- Trivadis 命名：l_（本地）、in_（输入）、io_（输入输出）、co_（常量）

NOT for backend APIs, database design, DevOps, testing frameworks, state management libraries, routing, or full SSR framework setup.
wyattowalsh/agents/frontend-designer.descriptionCn: 使用现代 React、Tailwind CSS 和 shadcn/ui 构建生产级前端界面。五种模式：脚手架项目、创建组件、配置主题和设计令牌、重构样式和审核代码库。编码 React 19 服务器组件（依赖于框架）、TailwindCSS v4 CSS-first 配置、带有 Radix 原语的 shadcn/ui、现代 CSS（容器查询、:has()、视图转换、滚动驱动动画）、Monaspace 排版和 Vite 6 的最佳实践。取代前端设计技能。在构建、样式化、主题化或改进任何前端项目时使用。不适用于后端 API、数据库设计、DevOps、测试框架、状态管理库、路由或完整的 SSR 框架设置。

wyattowalsh/agents/git-workflow.title: git-workflow
wyattowalsh/agents/git-workflow.description: Git operations: conventional commits, PR descriptions, branch strategy, conflict resolution, code archaeology, bisect. Use for git workflow tasks. NOT for code review, CI/CD, or changelogs.
wyattowalsh/agents/git-workflow.descriptionEn: Git operations: conventional commits, PR descriptions, branch strategy, conflict resolution, code archaeology, bisect. Use for git workflow tasks. NOT for code review, CI/CD, or changelogs.
wyattowalsh/agents/git-workflow.descriptionCn: Git 操作：常规提交、PR 描述、分支策略、冲突解决、代码考古、二等分。用于 git 工作流程任务。不适用于代码审查、CI/CD 或变更日志。

wyattowalsh/agents/honest-review.title: honest-review
wyattowalsh/agents/honest-review.description: Research-driven code review at multiple abstraction levels with strengths acknowledgment, creative review lenses, AI code smell detection, and severity calibration by project type. Two modes: (1) Session review — review and verify changes using parallel reviewers that research-validate every assumption; (2) Full codebase audit — deep end-to-end evaluation using parallel teams of subagent-spawning reviewers. Use when reviewing changes, verifying work quality, auditing a codebase, validating correctness, checking assumptions, finding defects, reducing complexity. NOT for writing new code, explaining code, or benchmarking.
wyattowalsh/agents/honest-review.descriptionEn: Research-driven code review at multiple abstraction levels with strengths acknowledgment, creative review lenses, AI code smell detection, and severity calibration by project type. Two modes: (1) Session review — review and verify changes using parallel reviewers that research-validate every assumption; (2) Full codebase audit — deep end-to-end evaluation using parallel teams of subagent-spawning reviewers. Use when reviewing changes, verifying work quality, auditing a codebase, validating correctness, checking assumptions, finding defects, reducing complexity. NOT for writing new code, explaining code, or benchmarking.
wyattowalsh/agents/honest-review.descriptionCn: 研究驱动的多个抽象级别的代码审查，包括优势认可、创意审查镜头、人工智能代码气味检测以及按项目类型进行的严重性校准。两种模式：（1）会议审查——使用平行审查者审查和验证变更，研究验证每个假设； (2) 完整的代码库审计——使用由子代理生成的审核者组成的平行团队进行深入的端到端评估。在审查变更、验证工作质量、审核代码库、验证正确性、检查假设、发现缺陷、降低复杂性时使用。不适用于编写新代码、解释代码或基准测试。

wyattowalsh/agents/host-panel.title: host-panel
wyattowalsh/agents/host-panel.description: Host simulated panel discussions and debates among AI-simulated domain experts. wyattowalsh/agents/host-panel.descriptionEn: Host simulated panel discussions and debates among AI-simulated domain experts. wyattowalsh/agents/infrastructure-coder.title: infrastructure-coder

wyattowalsh/agents/infrastructure-coder.descriptionEn: Infrastructure-as-Code: Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker. Generate, review, cost-compare, security-scan. Use for IaC work. NOT for CI/CD (devops-engineer), application code, or actual pricing.

wyattowalsh/agents/mcp-creator.title: mcp-creator

wyattowalsh/agents/prompt-engineer.title: prompt-engineer
wyattowalsh/agents/prompt-engineer.description: Comprehensive prompt and context engineering for any AI system. Adapts all recommendations to model class (instruction-following vs reasoning). Validates findings against current documentation. Use for system prompts, agent prompts, RAG pipelines, tool definitions, or any LLM context design. NOT for running prompts, generating content, or building agents.
wyattowalsh/agents/prompt-engineer.descriptionEn: Comprehensive prompt and context engineering for any AI system. Adapts all recommendations to model class (instruction-following vs reasoning). Validates findings against current documentation. Use for system prompts, agent prompts, RAG pipelines, tool definitions, or any LLM context design. NOT for running prompts, generating content, or building agents.

当用户需要以下分析时触发此 skill：
- 分析某品牌/企业/产品的社交媒体声誉和口碑
- 追踪热点舆情事件（如某车企被抨击、某明星争议事件）

1. **Word/PDF 文档** - 使用 docx/pdf subskill 生成，适合正式汇报、打印、存档
2. **高设计质量 HTML 报告** - 使用 frontend-design subskill，独特的编辑杂志风格，交互式可视化

xtone/ai_development_tools/code-review.description: PRやコード変更の汎用コードレビューを実施します。コードの品質、セキュリティ、設計を共通基準で評価し、approve/rejectを判断します。「このPRをレビュー」「コードレビューして」「マージ前チェック」などの依頼や、gh pr viewコマンドの実行時に使用してください。

yangxunj/claude-code-session-manager/ses.title: session-manager
yangxunj/claude-code-session-manager/ses.description:
Session expert management system for Claude Code projects. Enables tracking, routing, activating, and registering conversation sessions as domain experts. Use this skill when:
(1) Setting up session management for a new project (initialization)
(2) A user requests a feature change, bug fix, or optimization and you need to check if a session expert already handles that domain (routing)
(3) A session has accumulated deep domain context and should register itself as an expert (registration)
(4) An existing session expert needs to update its registration after scope changes (update)
(5) A session is expired and needs to be activated for resuming (activation)
(6) The user asks about managing, organizing, or optimizing session documentation

yanhongxi-openclaw/proactive-self-improv.description: 自动捕获经验并安全进化的技能。触发条件：(1)命令/操作失败时→记ERRORS.md (2)被用户纠正('不对'/'应该是')时→记LEARNINGS.md (3)用户需要不存在的能力时→记FEATURE_REQUESTS.md (4)外部API/工具出错时→记ERRORS.md (5)发现自己知识过时/错误时→记LEARNINGS.md (6)发现更好做法时→记LEARNINGS.md (7)每个任务完成时→回顾过程，有新经验则记LEARNINGS.md。去重原则：如果没有新经验或已有条目已覆盖则跳过不写。每次写入同时在.learnings/CHANGELOG.md追加JSONL日志。经验反复出现≥3次时晋升到AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md/SOUL.md。详见正文。

yanhongxi-openclaw/proactive-self-improv.descriptionCn: 自动捕捉经验并安全发展。触发条件： (1) 命令/操作失败 → 记录到 ERRORS.md (2) 用户更正（“错误”/“应该”） → 记录到 LEARNINGS.md (3) 用户需要不存在的能力 → 记录到 FEATURE_REQUESTS.md (4) 外部 API/工具错误 → 记录到 ERRORS.md (5) 发现知识过时/不正确 → 记录到 LEARNINGS.md (6) 找到更好的练习 → 记录到 LEARNINGS.md (7) 每个任务结束 → 回顾流程，将新课程记录到 LEARNINGS.md。重复数据删除：如果没有新的见解或已经涵盖，请跳过。每次写入时将 JSONL 条目附加到 .learnings/CHANGELOG.md。将重复经验提升至 AGENTS.md/TOOLS.md/SOUL.md ≥3 次。详细信息请参阅正文。

yankeguo/weavgui/weavgui.title: weavgui
yankeguo/weavgui/weavgui.description: Automate desktop GUI operations using the weavgui CLI: taking screenshots, moving the mouse, clicking, typing keystrokes, and reading/writing the system pasteboard. Use when asked to interact with the desktop graphically — clicking UI elements, reading on-screen content, filling forms, navigating applications, or any task requiring precise mouse control and visual feedback.
yankeguo/weavgui/weavgui.descriptionEn: Automate desktop GUI operations using the weavgui CLI: taking screenshots, moving the mouse, clicking, typing keystrokes, and reading/writing the system pasteboard. Use when asked to interact with the desktop graphically — clicking UI elements, reading on-screen content, filling forms, navigating applications, or any task requiring precise mouse control and visual feedback.
yankeguo/weavgui/weavgui.descriptionCn: 使用 weavgui CLI 自动化桌面 GUI 操作：截取屏幕截图、移动鼠标​​、单击、键入按键以及读取/写入系统粘贴板。当被要求以图形方式与桌面交互时使用 - 单击 UI 元素、阅读屏幕内容、填写表单、导航应用程序或任何需要精确鼠标控制和视觉反馈的任务。

yankeguo/weavmail/openspec-explore.title: openspec-explore
yankeguo/weavmail/openspec-explore.description: Enter explore mode - a thinking partner for exploring ideas, investigating problems, and clarifying requirements. Use when the user wants to think through something before or during a change.
yankeguo/weavmail/openspec-explore.descriptionEn: Enter explore mode - a thinking partner for exploring ideas, investigating problems, and clarifying requirements. Use when the user wants to think through something before or during a change.
yankeguo/weavmail/openspec-explore.descriptionCn: 进入探索模式——探索想法、调查问题和澄清需求的思考伙伴。当用户想要在更改之前或更改期间仔细考虑某些事情时使用。

yankeguo/weavmail/openspec-ff-change.title: openspec-ff-change
yankeguo/weavmail/openspec-ff-change.description: Fast-forward through OpenSpec artifact creation. Use when the user wants to quickly create all artifacts needed for implementation without stepping through each one individually.
yankeguo/weavmail/openspec-ff-change.descriptionEn: Fast-forward through OpenSpec artifact creation. Use when the user wants to quickly create all artifacts needed for implementation without stepping through each one individually.
yankeguo/weavmail/openspec-ff-change.descriptionCn: 快进通过 OpenSpec 工件创建。当用户想要快速创建实现所需的所有工件而不单独逐步执行每个工件时使用。

yankeguo/weavmail/weavmail.title: weavmail
yankeguo/weavmail/weavmail.description: Use weavmail CLI to manage emails for the current task. Use when you need to read, send, reply to, or move emails as part of completing a task.
yankeguo/weavmail/weavmail.descriptionEn: Use weavmail CLI to manage emails for the current task. Use when you need to read, send, reply to, or move emails as part of completing a task.
yankeguo/weavmail/weavmail.descriptionCn: 使用 weavmail CLI 管理当前任务的电子邮件。当您需要阅读、发送、回复或移动电子邮件作为完成任务的一部分时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/aaa-pattern.title: aaa-pattern
yanko-belov/code-craft/aaa-pattern.description: Use when writing tests. Use when test structure is unclear. Use when arrange/act/assert phases are mixed.
yanko-belov/code-craft/aaa-pattern.descriptionEn: Use when writing tests. Use when test structure is unclear. Use when arrange/act/assert phases are mixed.
yanko-belov/code-craft/aaa-pattern.descriptionCn: 编写测试时使用。当测试结构不清楚时使用。当排列/执行/断言阶段混合时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/api-versioning.title: api-versioning
yanko-belov/code-craft/api-versioning.description: Use when designing or modifying APIs. Use when adding breaking changes. Use when clients depend on API stability.
yanko-belov/code-craft/api-versioning.descriptionEn: Use when designing or modifying APIs. Use when adding breaking changes. Use when clients depend on API stability.
yanko-belov/code-craft/api-versioning.descriptionCn: 在设计或修改 API 时使用。添加重大更改时使用。当客户端依赖 API 稳定性时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/auth-patterns.title: auth-patterns
yanko-belov/code-craft/auth-patterns.description: Use when implementing authentication. Use when storing passwords. Use when asked to store credentials insecurely.
yanko-belov/code-craft/auth-patterns.descriptionEn: Use when implementing authentication. Use when storing passwords. Use when asked to store credentials insecurely.
yanko-belov/code-craft/auth-patterns.descriptionCn: 实施身份验证时使用。存储密码时使用。当要求不安全地存储凭据时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/caching.title: caching
yanko-belov/code-craft/caching.description: Use when same data is fetched repeatedly. Use when database queries are slow. Use when implementing caching without invalidation strategy.
yanko-belov/code-craft/caching.descriptionEn: Use when same data is fetched repeatedly. Use when database queries are slow. Use when implementing caching without invalidation strategy.
yanko-belov/code-craft/caching.descriptionCn: 当重复获取相同数据时使用。当数据库查询速度慢时使用。在实现没有失效策略的缓存时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/composition-over-.title: composition-over-inheritance
yanko-belov/code-craft/composition-over-.description: Use when tempted to use class inheritance. Use when creating class hierarchies. Use when subclass needs only some parent behavior.
yanko-belov/code-craft/composition-over-.descriptionEn: Use when tempted to use class inheritance. Use when creating class hierarchies. Use when subclass needs only some parent behavior.
yanko-belov/code-craft/composition-over-.descriptionCn: 当想要使用类继承时使用。创建类层次结构时使用。当子类只需要一些父类行为时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/deadlock-preventi.title: deadlock-prevention
yanko-belov/code-craft/deadlock-preventi.description: Use when acquiring multiple locks. Use when operations wait for each other. Use when system hangs without crashing.
yanko-belov/code-craft/deadlock-preventi.descriptionEn: Use when acquiring multiple locks. Use when operations wait for each other. Use when system hangs without crashing.
yanko-belov/code-craft/deadlock-preventi.descriptionCn: 获取多个锁时使用。当操作相互等待时使用。当系统挂起但没有崩溃时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/dependency-invers.title: dependency-inversion-principle
yanko-belov/code-craft/dependency-invers.description: Use when a class creates its own dependencies. Use when instantiating concrete implementations inside a class. Use when told to avoid dependency injection for simplicity.
yanko-belov/code-craft/dependency-invers.descriptionEn: Use when a class creates its own dependencies. Use when instantiating concrete implementations inside a class. Use when told to avoid dependency injection for simplicity.
yanko-belov/code-craft/dependency-invers.descriptionCn: 当类创建自己的依赖项时使用。在类内实例化具体实现时使用。为了简单起见，在被告知避免依赖注入时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/dont-repeat-yours.title: dont-repeat-yourself
yanko-belov/code-craft/dont-repeat-yours.description: Use when writing similar code in multiple places. Use when copy-pasting code. Use when making the same change in multiple locations.
yanko-belov/code-craft/dont-repeat-yours.descriptionEn: Use when writing similar code in multiple places. Use when copy-pasting code. Use when making the same change in multiple locations.
yanko-belov/code-craft/dont-repeat-yours.descriptionCn: 在多个地方编写类似的代码时使用。复制粘贴代码时使用。在多个位置进行相同更改时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/encapsulation.title: encapsulation
yanko-belov/code-craft/encapsulation.description: Use when exposing internal state. Use when making fields public for convenience. Use when external code modifies object internals.
yanko-belov/code-craft/encapsulation.descriptionEn: Use when exposing internal state. Use when making fields public for convenience. Use when external code modifies object internals.
yanko-belov/code-craft/encapsulation.descriptionCn: 暴露内部状态时使用。为了方便起见，在公开字段时使用。当外部代码修改对象内部时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/error-boundaries.title: error-boundaries
yanko-belov/code-craft/error-boundaries.description: Use when deciding where to catch errors. Use when errors propagate too far or not far enough. Use when designing component/service isolation.
yanko-belov/code-craft/error-boundaries.descriptionEn: Use when deciding where to catch errors. Use when errors propagate too far or not far enough. Use when designing component/service isolation.
yanko-belov/code-craft/error-boundaries.descriptionCn: 在决定在哪里捕获错误时使用。当错误传播得太远或不够远时使用。在设计组件/服务隔离时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/error-responses.title: error-responses
yanko-belov/code-craft/error-responses.description: Use when returning errors from APIs. Use when exposing internal errors. Use when error responses lack structure.
yanko-belov/code-craft/error-responses.descriptionEn: Use when returning errors from APIs. Use when exposing internal errors. Use when error responses lack structure.
yanko-belov/code-craft/error-responses.descriptionCn: 从 API 返回错误时使用。当暴露内部错误时使用。当错误响应缺乏结构时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/exception-hierarc.title: exception-hierarchies
yanko-belov/code-craft/exception-hierarc.description: Use when creating custom exceptions. Use when error handling feels chaotic. Use when catch blocks are too broad or too specific.
yanko-belov/code-craft/exception-hierarc.descriptionEn: Use when creating custom exceptions. Use when error handling feels chaotic. Use when catch blocks are too broad or too specific.
yanko-belov/code-craft/exception-hierarc.descriptionCn: 创建自定义异常时使用。当错误处理感觉混乱时使用。当 catch 块太宽泛或太具体时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/fail-fast.title: fail-fast
yanko-belov/code-craft/fail-fast.description: Use when handling errors. Use when tempted to catch and swallow exceptions. Use when returning default values to hide failures.
yanko-belov/code-craft/fail-fast.descriptionEn: Use when handling errors. Use when tempted to catch and swallow exceptions. Use when returning default values to hide failures.
yanko-belov/code-craft/fail-fast.descriptionCn: 处理错误时使用。当想要捕获并吞下异常时使用。在返回默认值时使用以隐藏失败。

yanko-belov/code-craft/idempotency.title: idempotency
yanko-belov/code-craft/idempotency.description: Use when creating mutation endpoints. Use when trusting frontend to prevent duplicates. Use when payments or critical operations can be repeated.
yanko-belov/code-craft/idempotency.descriptionEn: Use when creating mutation endpoints. Use when trusting frontend to prevent duplicates. Use when payments or critical operations can be repeated.
yanko-belov/code-craft/idempotency.descriptionCn: 创建突变端点时使用。在信任前端时使用以防止重复。当付款或关键操作可以重复时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/immutability.title: immutability
yanko-belov/code-craft/immutability.description: Use when modifying objects or arrays. Use when tempted to mutate function parameters. Use when state changes cause unexpected bugs.
yanko-belov/code-craft/immutability.descriptionEn: Use when modifying objects or arrays. Use when tempted to mutate function parameters. Use when state changes cause unexpected bugs.
yanko-belov/code-craft/immutability.descriptionCn: 在修改对象或数组时使用。当想要改变函数参数时使用。当状态更改导致意外错误时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/input-validation.title: input-validation
yanko-belov/code-craft/input-validation.description: Use when accepting user input. Use when handling request data. Use when trusting external data without validation.
yanko-belov/code-craft/input-validation.descriptionEn: Use when accepting user input. Use when handling request data. Use when trusting external data without validation.
yanko-belov/code-craft/input-validation.descriptionCn: 接受用户输入时使用。处理请求数据时使用。在信任外部数据而不进行验证时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/interface-segrega.title: interface-segregation-principle
yanko-belov/code-craft/interface-segrega.description: Use when designing interfaces. Use when implementing interfaces with methods you don't need. Use when forced to implement throw/no-op for interface methods.
yanko-belov/code-craft/interface-segrega.descriptionEn: Use when designing interfaces. Use when implementing interfaces with methods you don't need. Use when forced to implement throw/no-op for interface methods.
yanko-belov/code-craft/interface-segrega.descriptionCn: 设计界面时使用。在使用不需要的方法实现接口时使用。当被迫为接口方法实现 throw/no-op 时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/keep-it-simple.title: keep-it-simple
yanko-belov/code-craft/keep-it-simple.description: Use when tempted to write clever code. Use when solution feels complex. Use when showing off skills instead of solving problems.
yanko-belov/code-craft/keep-it-simple.descriptionEn: Use when tempted to write clever code. Use when solution feels complex. Use when showing off skills instead of solving problems.
yanko-belov/code-craft/keep-it-simple.descriptionCn: 当想要编写聪明的代码时使用。当解决方案感觉复杂时使用。当炫耀技能而不是解决问题时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/law-of-demeter.title: law-of-demeter
yanko-belov/code-craft/law-of-demeter.description: Use when accessing nested object properties. Use when chaining method calls. Use when reaching through objects to get data.
yanko-belov/code-craft/law-of-demeter.descriptionEn: Use when accessing nested object properties. Use when chaining method calls. Use when reaching through objects to get data.
yanko-belov/code-craft/law-of-demeter.descriptionCn: 在访问嵌套对象属性时使用。在链接方法调用时使用。当通过对象获取数据时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/lazy-loading.title: lazy-loading
yanko-belov/code-craft/lazy-loading.description: Use when loading all data upfront. Use when initial page load is slow. Use when fetching data that might not be needed.
yanko-belov/code-craft/lazy-loading.descriptionEn: Use when loading all data upfront. Use when initial page load is slow. Use when fetching data that might not be needed.
yanko-belov/code-craft/lazy-loading.descriptionCn: 预先加载所有数据时使用。当初始页面加载缓慢时使用。在获取可能不需要的数据时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/liskov-substituti.title: liskov-substitution-principle
yanko-belov/code-craft/liskov-substituti.description: Use when creating subclasses or implementing interfaces. Use when tempted to override methods with exceptions or no-ops. Use when inheritance hierarchy feels wrong.
yanko-belov/code-craft/liskov-substituti.descriptionEn: Use when creating subclasses or implementing interfaces. Use when tempted to override methods with exceptions or no-ops. Use when inheritance hierarchy feels wrong.
yanko-belov/code-craft/liskov-substituti.descriptionCn: 在创建子类或实现接口时使用。当想要重写带有异常或无操作的方法时使用。当感觉继承层次结构错误时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/n-plus-one-preven.title: n-plus-one-prevention
yanko-belov/code-craft/n-plus-one-preven.description: Use when fetching related data in loops. Use when seeing multiple queries for one request. Use when database is slow on list endpoints.
yanko-belov/code-craft/n-plus-one-preven.descriptionEn: Use when fetching related data in loops. Use when seeing multiple queries for one request. Use when database is slow on list endpoints.
yanko-belov/code-craft/n-plus-one-preven.descriptionCn: 在循环中获取相关数据时使用。当看到一个请求有多个查询时使用。当数据库在列表端点上速度缓慢时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/open-closed-princ.title: open-closed-principle
yanko-belov/code-craft/open-closed-princ.description: Use when adding new functionality to existing code. Use when tempted to add if/else or switch branches. Use when extending behavior of existing classes.
yanko-belov/code-craft/open-closed-princ.descriptionEn: Use when adding new functionality to existing code. Use when tempted to add if/else or switch branches. Use when extending behavior of existing classes.
yanko-belov/code-craft/open-closed-princ.descriptionCn: 在向现有代码添加新功能时使用。当想要添加 if/else 或 switch 分支时使用。在扩展现有类的行为时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/race-conditions.title: race-conditions
yanko-belov/code-craft/race-conditions.description: Use when multiple operations access shared state. Use when order of operations matters. Use when "it works most of the time" but occasionally fails mysteriously.
yanko-belov/code-craft/race-conditions.descriptionEn: Use when multiple operations access shared state. Use when order of operations matters. Use when "it works most of the time" but occasionally fails mysteriously.
yanko-belov/code-craft/race-conditions.descriptionCn: 当多个操作访问共享状态时使用。当操作顺序很重要时使用。当“大部分时间都有效”但偶尔会莫名其妙地失败时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/rest-conventions.title: rest-conventions
yanko-belov/code-craft/rest-conventions.description: Use when designing API endpoints. Use when using wrong HTTP methods. Use when POST is used for reads.
yanko-belov/code-craft/rest-conventions.descriptionEn: Use when designing API endpoints. Use when using wrong HTTP methods. Use when POST is used for reads.
yanko-belov/code-craft/rest-conventions.descriptionCn: 在设计 API 端点时使用。当使用错误的 HTTP 方法时使用。当使用 POST 进行读取时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/secrets-handling.title: secrets-handling
yanko-belov/code-craft/secrets-handling.description: Use when working with API keys, passwords, or credentials. Use when asked to hardcode secrets. Use when secrets might leak.
yanko-belov/code-craft/secrets-handling.descriptionEn: Use when working with API keys, passwords, or credentials. Use when asked to hardcode secrets. Use when secrets might leak.
yanko-belov/code-craft/secrets-handling.descriptionCn: 在使用 API 密钥、密码或凭据时使用。当要求对秘密进行硬编码时使用。当秘密可能泄露时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/separation-of-con.title: separation-of-concerns
yanko-belov/code-craft/separation-of-con.description: Use when component does too many things. Use when mixing data fetching, logic, and presentation. Use when code is hard to test.
yanko-belov/code-craft/separation-of-con.descriptionEn: Use when component does too many things. Use when mixing data fetching, logic, and presentation. Use when code is hard to test.
yanko-belov/code-craft/separation-of-con.descriptionCn: 当组件做太多事情时使用。在混合数据获取、逻辑和表示时使用。当代码难以测试时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/single-responsibi.title: single-responsibility-principle
yanko-belov/code-craft/single-responsibi.description: Use when creating or modifying classes, modules, or functions. Use when feeling pressure to add functionality to existing code. Use when class has multiple reasons to change.
yanko-belov/code-craft/single-responsibi.descriptionEn: Use when creating or modifying classes, modules, or functions. Use when feeling pressure to add functionality to existing code. Use when class has multiple reasons to change.
yanko-belov/code-craft/single-responsibi.descriptionCn: 在创建或修改类、模块或函数时使用。当感到有压力向现有代码添加功能时使用。当类有多种原因需要更改时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/skill-awareness.title: skill-awareness
yanko-belov/code-craft/skill-awareness.description: Always active. Tracks usage of code-craft skills across sessions. Log skill applications to enable analytics and identify gaps.
yanko-belov/code-craft/skill-awareness.descriptionEn: Always active. Tracks usage of code-craft skills across sessions. Log skill applications to enable analytics and identify gaps.
yanko-belov/code-craft/skill-awareness.descriptionCn: 始终活跃。跟踪跨会话的代码制作技能的使用情况。记录技能应用程序以进行分析并识别差距。

yanko-belov/code-craft/test-driven-devel.title: test-driven-development
yanko-belov/code-craft/test-driven-devel.description: Use when implementing any new feature or function. Use when asked to "add tests later". Use when writing code before tests.
yanko-belov/code-craft/test-driven-devel.descriptionEn: Use when implementing any new feature or function. Use when asked to "add tests later". Use when writing code before tests.
yanko-belov/code-craft/test-driven-devel.descriptionCn: 在实现任何新特性或功能时使用。当被要求“稍后添加测试”时使用。在测试之前编写代码时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/test-isolation.title: test-isolation
yanko-belov/code-craft/test-isolation.description: Use when writing tests that share state. Use when tests depend on other tests. Use when test order matters.
yanko-belov/code-craft/test-isolation.descriptionEn: Use when writing tests that share state. Use when tests depend on other tests. Use when test order matters.
yanko-belov/code-craft/test-isolation.descriptionCn: 在编写共享状态的测试时使用。当测试依赖于其他测试时使用。当测试顺序很重要时使用。

yanko-belov/code-craft/you-aint-gonna-ne.title: you-aint-gonna-need-it
yanko-belov/code-craft/you-aint-gonna-ne.description: Use when tempted to add features "for later". Use when building "production-ready" systems before needed. Use when adding flexibility that isn't required yet.
yanko-belov/code-craft/you-aint-gonna-ne.descriptionEn: Use when tempted to add features "for later". Use when building "production-ready" systems before needed. Use when adding flexibility that isn't required yet.

yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/scope-guard.title: scope-guard
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/scope-guard.description: コミットやPR作成前に「意図しない差分」を検出し、ブランチ目的とのズレを警告する。 混入した無関係な変更の破棄コマンドまで提示する。コミット前のスコープ確認、 差分に余計なファイルが混ざっていないかのチェック、PRのスコープが広がりすぎていないかの 検証で使うこと。「このブランチの目的と関係ない変更が入っていないか？」という 疑問があれば必ず使うこと。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/scope-guard.descriptionEn: コミットやPR作成前に「意図しない差分」を検出し、ブランチ目的とのズレを警告する。 混入した無関係な変更の破棄コマンドまで提示する。コミット前のスコープ確認、 差分に余計なファイルが混ざっていないかのチェック、PRのスコープが広がりすぎていないかの 検証で使うこと。「このブランチの目的と関係ない変更が入っていないか？」という 疑問があれば必ず使うこと。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/scope-guard.descriptionCn: 在提交或 PR 创建之前检测“意外差异”，并在它们偏离分支目的时发出警报。它甚至建议命令放弃不相关的更改。使用它进行预提交范围检查，验证没有额外的文件混合到差异中，并确保 PR 不会变得太大。每当您想知道“是否包含与此分支的用途无关的任何更改？”时，请始终使用它。

yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-audit-q.title: security-audit-quick
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-audit-q.description: 高速静的セキュリティスキャン。grepベースで既知の危険パターン（XSS、SQLインジェクション、 ハードコード秘密鍵など）を網羅的に検出し、SEVERITY / file:line / why / fix 形式で 出力する再現可能なワークフロー。「コードベース全体をざっとセキュリティチェックしたい」 「既知の脆弱性パターンを一括検出したい」ときに使うこと。 security-hardeningスキル（特定の脅威シナリオに対する設計〜実装）や security-threat-reviewスキル（レッド/ブルーチームによる包括評価）とは異なり、 このスキルは既知パターンの高速検出に特化している。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-audit-q.descriptionEn: 高速静的セキュリティスキャン。grepベースで既知の危険パターン（XSS、SQLインジェクション、 ハードコード秘密鍵など）を網羅的に検出し、SEVERITY / file:line / why / fix 形式で 出力する再現可能なワークフロー。「コードベース全体をざっとセキュリティチェックしたい」 「既知の脆弱性パターンを一括検出したい」ときに使うこと。 security-hardeningスキル（特定の脅威シナリオに対する設計〜実装）や security-threat-reviewスキル（レッド/ブルーチームによる包括評価）とは異なり、 このスキルは既知パターンの高速検出に特化している。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-audit-q.descriptionCn: 高速静态安全扫描。基于 Grep 的已知危险模式（XSS、SQL 注入、硬编码机密等）的详尽检测，并以 SEVERITY / file:line / Why / fix 格式输出可重现的工作流程。当您想要“快速安全检查整个代码库”或“批量检测已知漏洞模式”时，请使用它。与安全强化技能（特定威胁场景的设计到实施）或安全威胁审查技能（全面的红/蓝团队评估）不同，该技能仅专注于已知模式的高速检测。

yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-hardeni.title: security-hardening
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-hardeni.description: 特定の脅威シナリオに対するセキュリティ強化ワークフロー。「IDORを防ぎたい」 「CSRFの対策を設計したい」「RLSを強化したい」のように、単一の具体的な脅威を入力に、 脅威モデル→緩和設計→実装方針→テスト/ログ→release-gate化まで一貫して成果物を出力する。 IDOR、リプレイ攻撃、CSRF、XSS、パストラバーサル、オープンリダイレクト、 レート制限設計など、特定の脆弱性への対処で使うこと。 「コードベース全体をスキャンしたい」場合はsecurity-audit-quickを、 「アプリ全体を包括評価したい」場合はsecurity-threat-reviewを使うこと。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-hardeni.descriptionEn: 特定の脅威シナリオに対するセキュリティ強化ワークフロー。「IDORを防ぎたい」 「CSRFの対策を設計したい」「RLSを強化したい」のように、単一の具体的な脅威を入力に、 脅威モデル→緩和設計→実装方針→テスト/ログ→release-gate化まで一貫して成果物を出力する。 IDOR、リプレイ攻撃、CSRF、XSS、パストラバーサル、オープンリダイレクト、 レート制限設計など、特定の脆弱性への対処で使うこと。 「コードベース全体をスキャンしたい」場合はsecurity-audit-quickを、 「アプリ全体を包括評価したい」場合はsecurity-threat-reviewを使うこと。
yusuketsunoda/ppt-trans/security-hardeni.descriptionCn:
针对特定威胁场景的安全强化工作流程。  
输入单个具体威胁，例如“防止 IDOR”、“设计 CSRF 对策”或“加强 RLS”，它就会一致地提供来自威胁建模 → 缓解设计 → 实施计划 → 测试/记录 → 发布门的工件。  
使用它进行有针对性的修复：IDOR、重放攻击、CSRF、XSS、路径遍历、开放重定向、速率限制设计等。

zephyrwang6/myskill/logo-batch-generator.title: logo-batch-generator
zephyrwang6/myskill/logo-batch-generator.description: 批量生成品牌Logo。支持两种入口：(1)用户描述品牌/用途后批量生成10个Logo变体 (2)用户上传参考图片后分析并生成Logo。提供7种主流风格选择。调用Gemini API生成，保存到Obsidian图片目录。触发词："生成Logo"、"设计Logo"、"做个Logo"、"批量Logo"、"帮我设计一个标志"。

zephyrwang6/myskill/markdown-to-image.title: markdown-to-image

zephyrwang6/myskill/mcp-builder.title: mcp-builder
zephyrwang6/myskill/mcp-builder.description: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers that enable LLMs to interact with external services through well-designed tools. Use when building MCP servers to integrate external APIs or services, whether in Python (FastMCP) or Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK).

zephyrwang6/myskill/mcp-builder.descriptionCn: 创建高质量 MCP（模型上下文协议）服务器的指南，使 LLM 能够通过精心设计的工具与外部服务交互。在构建 MCP 服务器以集成外部 API 或服务时使用，无论是使用 Python (FastMCP) 还是 Node/TypeScript (MCP SDK)。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-file-scan.title: mem-file-scan
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-file-scan.description: AI个人记忆系统的文件扫描回顾功能。扫描Obsidian仓库中本周修改的文件（排除AI_MEMORY目录），识别潜在的重要事件和决策。使用场景：(1) 用户说"文件扫描"、"查看本周文件"、"扫描文件变化"时；(2) 周复盘时补充L1记录前；(3) 用户想回顾本周在Obsidian中的活动时。该skill会列出修改的文件，询问用户哪些需要记录到L1，并辅助记录。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-file-scan.descriptionEn: AI个人记忆系统的文件扫描回顾功能。扫描Obsidian仓库中本周修改的文件（排除AI_MEMORY目录），识别潜在的重要事件和决策。使用场景：(1) 用户说"文件扫描"、"查看本周文件"、"扫描文件变化"时；(2) 周复盘时补充L1记录前；(3) 用户想回顾本周在Obsidian中的活动时。该skill会列出修改的文件，询问用户哪些需要记录到L1，并辅助记录。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-file-scan.descriptionCn: 人工智能个人记忆系统的文件扫描审查功能。扫描本周在黑曜石保管库中修改的文件（不包括 AI_MEMORY 文件夹），以识别潜在的重要事件和决策。用例：（1）当用户说“文件扫描”、“检查本周的文件”或“扫描文件更改”时； （2）每周复习前补充L1记录； (3)当用户想要回顾本周Obsidian的活动时。该技能列出了修改过的文件，询问用户哪些文件应该记录在L1中，并协助记录它们。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-monthly.title: mem-monthly
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-monthly.description: AI个人记忆系统的月度复盘功能。分析本月L2行为层更新，提炼思维模式到L3认知层，检查L4核心层是否需要校准。使用场景：(1) 用户说"月复盘"时；(2) 每月末定期回顾时；(3) 需要从行为模式提炼认知框架时。该skill会分析多个行为是否指向同一思维原则，尝试提炼到L3，并引导用户反思L4核心层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-monthly.descriptionEn: AI个人记忆系统的月度复盘功能。分析本月L2行为层更新，提炼思维模式到L3认知层，检查L4核心层是否需要校准。使用场景：(1) 用户说"月复盘"时；(2) 每月末定期回顾时；(3) 需要从行为模式提炼认知框架时。该skill会分析多个行为是否指向同一思维原则，尝试提炼到L3，并引导用户反思L4核心层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-monthly.descriptionCn: AI个人记忆系统每月回顾功能。分析本月L2行为层的更新，将思维模式提炼到L3认知层，检查L4核心层是否需要校准。用例：（1）当用户说“每月回顾”时； (2) 定期月末评审期间； (3) 当行为模式需要被提炼成认知框架时。该技能会分析多个行为是否指向同一个思维原理，尝试将其提炼成L3，并引导用户反思L4核心层。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-query.title: mem-query
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-query.description: AI个人记忆系统的记忆查询功能。检索各层级记忆文件，综合多层级信息回答用户问题。使用场景：(1) 用户问"我的记忆中关于XXX"时；(2) 用户询问自己的习惯/偏好/价值观时；(3) 需要基于用户历史提供建议时。该skill会自动检索L1-L4各层级，引用来源，给出基于记忆的个性化回答。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-query.descriptionEn: AI个人记忆系统的记忆查询功能。检索各层级记忆文件，综合多层级信息回答用户问题。使用场景：(1) 用户问"我的记忆中关于XXX"时；(2) 用户询问自己的习惯/偏好/价值观时；(3) 需要基于用户历史提供建议时。该skill会自动检索L1-L4各层级，引用来源，给出基于记忆的个性化回答。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-query.descriptionCn: AI个人记忆系统的记忆查询功能。检索各级内存文件并综合多级信息来回答用户问题。用例：（1）当用户询问“在我的记忆中关于XXX”时； (2) 当用户询问其习惯/偏好/价值观时； (3) 根据用户历史提供推荐时。该技能会自动搜索 L1-L4 级别、引用来源并根据记忆给出个性化答案。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-record.title: mem-record
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-record.description: AI个人记忆系统的记忆记录功能。自动从对话中提炼关键信息并记录到相应层级。使用场景：(1) 用户说"记录到记忆系统"、"记住这个"、"把这次对话记下来"时；(2) 检测到重要事件、决策、偏好表达时；(3) 用户完成重要任务或做出决策时。该skill会自动判断应该记录到L1情境层、L2行为层、L3认知层，还是建议更新L4核心层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-record.descriptionEn: AI个人记忆系统的记忆记录功能。自动从对话中提炼关键信息并记录到相应层级。使用场景：(1) 用户说"记录到记忆系统"、"记住这个"、"把这次对话记下来"时；(2) 检测到重要事件、决策、偏好表达时；(3) 用户完成重要任务或做出决策时。该skill会自动判断应该记录到L1情境层、L2行为层、L3认知层，还是建议更新L4核心层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-record.descriptionCn:
AI个人记忆系统的记忆记录功能。自动从对话中提取关键信息并将其记录到适当的级别。  
使用案例：  
(1) 当用户说“记录到内存系统”、“记住这一点”或“保存本次对话”时；  
(2) 当检测到重要事件、决定或偏好表达时；  
(3)当用户完成一项重要任务或做出决定时。  

该技能自动确定是否记录到L1上下文层、L2行为层、L3认知层，或建议更新L4核心层。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-weekly.title: mem-weekly
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-weekly.description: AI个人记忆系统的周复盘功能。分析本周L1情境层记录，识别重复模式，提炼到L2行为层。使用场景：(1) 用户说"周复盘"时；(2) 每周定期回顾时；(3) 需要从日常记录中提炼行为模式时。该skill会自动统计重复出现的行为（3次+），生成候选列表，等待用户确认后更新L2行为层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-weekly.descriptionEn: AI个人记忆系统的周复盘功能。分析本周L1情境层记录，识别重复模式，提炼到L2行为层。使用场景：(1) 用户说"周复盘"时；(2) 每周定期回顾时；(3) 需要从日常记录中提炼行为模式时。该skill会自动统计重复出现的行为（3次+），生成候选列表，等待用户确认后更新L2行为层。
zephyrwang6/myskill/mem-weekly.descriptionCn:
AI个人记忆系统的每周回顾功能。分析本周的 L1 上下文层条目，识别重复出现的模式，并将其提炼到 L2 行为层。  
使用案例：  
（1）当用户说“周评”时；  
(2) 在预定的每周回顾期间；  
(3) 当日常记录需要提炼成行为模式时。  

该技能会自动统计重复 3 次以上的行为，生成候选列表，并在用户确认后更新 L2 行为层。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mermaid-generator.title: mermaid-generator
zephyrwang6/myskill/mermaid-generator.description: 将任意文本、工作流、逻辑转换为清晰简约的 Mermaid 流程图。支持 flowchart、sequence、class 等多种图表类型。使用场景：(1) 需要可视化工作流程，(2) 将文档/对话转为流程图，(3) 创建系统架构图，(4) 生成时序图/类图。自动保存到 Obsidian 画板目录，按日期和主题分类。

zephyrwang6/myskill/mermaid-generator.descriptionCn: 将任何文本、工作流程或逻辑转换为清晰简洁的美人鱼图。支持流程图、序列、类和更多图表类型。用例：(1) 可视化工作流程，(2) 将文档/对话转换为流程图，(3) 创建系统架构图，(4) 生成序列/类图。自动保存到 Obsidian 画布文件夹，按日期和主题排序。

zephyrwang6/myskill/pdf.title: pdf
zephyrwang6/myskill/pdf.description: Comprehensive PDF manipulation toolkit for extracting text and tables, creating new PDFs, merging/splitting documents, and handling forms. When Claude needs to fill in a PDF form or programmatically process, generate, or analyze PDF documents at scale.
zephyrwang6/myskill/pdf.descriptionEn: Comprehensive PDF manipulation toolkit for extracting text and tables, creating new PDFs, merging/splitting documents, and handling forms. When Claude needs to fill in a PDF form or programmatically process, generate, or analyze PDF documents at scale.
zephyrwang6/myskill/pdf.descriptionCn: 全面的 PDF 操作工具包，用于提取文本和表格、创建新的 PDF、合并/拆分文档以及处理表单。当 Claude 需要填写 PDF 表单或以编程方式大规模处理、生成或分析 PDF 文档时。

播客处理一站式工作流。支持两种入口：
(1) 直接处理：提供 YouTube 链接，直接进入处理流程
(2) 更新检查：获取关注博主的最新更新，用户挑选后处理

1）直接处理：提供YouTube链接并直接跳转到工作流程
